expected_structural_delta: One shared JS widget (about 160-220 lines), one CSS asset (about 50 lines), one documentation section and one consumer initialization. Delete about 85 page-local lines. Native select remains the sole value owner; no dependency, service, persistence or cross-repo contract.
minimum_design: Extract one opt-in jQuery UI widget and stylesheet, reuse bundled autocomplete and native select theme rules, and replace page-local behavior with initialization. Keep native select authoritative and each widget isolated.
outcome: Provide a reusable searchable single-select control and use it for Date and Time while preserving native form values and dropdown appearance.

reuse_decisions.name: Bundled jQuery UI widget/autocomplete
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing lifecycle and keyboard primitives avoid a dependency or copied state engine.

reuse_decisions.name: Opt-in shared asset loading
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing pages include shared jQuery plugins and CSS through autov; no global initialization is needed.

reuse_decisions.name: Native select and theme rules
reuse_decisions.rationale: Preserve submitted value, change, reset and disabled behavior while sharing its visual treatment.

reuse_decisions.name: Shared searchable select widget
reuse_decisions.rationale: User explicitly requests reusable assets; one owner replaces page-local behavior and prevents copying it into new consumers.
